title: Injectivity of auxiliary indices
statement: Let $a,K,r$ be natural numbers with $a+3\le K$. The map sending $j\in\{0,1,2\}$ to the coordinate in the block of $K$ indices, offset by $r$, whose within-block index is $a+j$, is injective.
